items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf); will test pregame per McVay. Crucial DFS slate status.
items.why: Calf; majority practice Thu but no Fri; feels lack of power/explosion.
items.implication: If OUT, heavy TE funnel + secondary WRs; monitor pregame.

items.text: Lamar Jackson QUESTIONABLE (ankle/high-ankle sprain); says heading right direction.
items.why: High ankle; limited practice, positive comments.
items.implication: Game-time; Ravens offense volatility if limited/out.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad); game-time lean possible miss but if active start.
items.implication: If active vs MIA, RB1; else Allen committee/RB1.

items.text: OUTs include Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Brian Robinson (plus Evans/Deebo/Charbonnet).
items.implication: Handcuffs/backups and TE/WR pivots elevated; Adams long-term.

items.text: 49ers ruled OUT Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel for Sunday vs ATL.
items.why: Evans Achilles/ribs; Deebo hamstring; coach confirm.
items.implication: Massive Kittle funnel + CMC receiving upside.

items.text: Zach Charbonnet OUT; Schefter confirm for SEA vs KC SNF.
Josh Jacobs IN (cleared; was facility/meetings only prior).
items.implication: Expected lead role but workload question post-layoff.

items.text: Saquon Barkley in line to return W7 vs DAL; if active, right back in lineups (efficient prior, DAL soft vs RBs).
items.why: Back at practice; efficient in full games played; matchup.
items.implication: Must-start RB if cleared for MNF.

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1 Higbee 2 Mumpfield 3 Parkinson 4 Atwell 5 Whittington 6 Allen.
items.why: Calf limits explosion; McVay pregame test.
items.implication: TE1/WR depth spike if OUT; Higbee primary beneficiary.
items.opportunity: TE target share historically 37% with Puka out + Adams long-term out

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK with Caleb: 30% ts, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec/60+ yds both games since return.
items.why: Caleb Williams return unlocked; Kmet IR further juice.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring); SF DvP inflates opp RB +4.4% (7th). Sweet full-opp setup for Bijan Robinson.
items.why: BRob OUT + SF conceding RB catches (White/Holani/Harvey/Love recent).
items.implication: Bijan RB1 with full workload vs soft DvP.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts: scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT). Not National TE Day.
items.why: WR outs create target vacuum in elite scheme.

items.text: Luther Burden 68.8% routes, elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet IR (season-ending knee) may cut 2/3-sets giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Kmet to IR confirmed; reduces multi-TE sets.

items.text: LOVE: AJ Brown (97% routes/33% ts buy), DeVonta Smith, Tucker Kraft, Jaylen Warren, Bucky Irving, Chuba Hubbard. HATE: Rome Odunze (Gonzalez shadow), Josh Downs, Travis Kelce, Josh Jacobs (layoff workload).
items.why: Usage (AJB routes/ts) + matchups (DET soft pass/TE; volume backs); hates tough shadows/low-scoring/role risk.
items.implication: Start loves; fade hates in W7.
items.opportunity: AJB routes; Kraft TE share vs DET; Warren workload
items.conflict: Jacobs IN but Berry hate vs ETR/Levitan notes
